title: 🃏 Card
description: A universal, schema.org-driven card. One structured envelope (headline, summary, media, authors, actions, engagement…) shared by every card, a `schemaType` discriminator covering 56 schema.org types (53 distinct itemtypes — `profile` and `artist` both resolve to Person; `comparison`, `places` and `filelist` all to ItemList), and a single `details` object for type-specific data. Presentation (variant/media/content tokens for <ui-card>/<ui-reveal>) deliberately lives OUTSIDE this model — in a referenced card-preset — so the same card can render as hero, grid item, overlay or flip by swapping one reference.

layout.name: Media
layout.description: Media items (more than one becomes a carousel) and overlay furniture

layout.name: Navigation
layout.description: Tags, call-to-action buttons and related links

layout.name: Type Details
layout.description: Schema-type-specific data, the look & feel preset, and the optional reveal flipside

internalName.title: Internal Name
internalName.description: Internal name for CMS editors — not displayed on the front end

schemaType.title: Schema Type
schemaType.description: schema.org content type. Drives the emitted itemtype, the microdata property mapping (headline → headline/name/title, summary → description/reviewBody) and which `details` shape applies.

options.label: Places — a collection on one map (ItemList)

chip.title: Status chip
chip.description:
A short status flag at the very top of the TEXT column, above the eyebrow — "New", "Sold", "Last places". Either one object or an ARRAY of them when a listing carries several flags; they render as one

row (which gains flex + gap only when it holds more than one chip). Each entry is { text, theme, size, radius, variant } — ui/chip’s own standalone attributes, written verbatim: theme is a ui-chip theme string (default "pale accent"), size sm|lg|xl|2xl, radius non|rnd|pll|crc|sqr (rnd is the square-cornered look), variant light|outline. NOT to be confused with `furniture.chip`, which is the chip overlaid on the MEDIA: a frame gets one chip family, so a furniture chip suppresses the type label, which is why a status flag belongs here instead.

size.title: Size
size.description: ui-chip size — sm | lg | xl | 2xl (md is the default)

radius.title: Corner
radius.description: ui-chip radius — non | rnd | pll | crc | sqr; pill is the default

cover.title: Cover link
cover.description: Makes the WHOLE card clickable: the headline text is wrapped in one <a data-part="cover"> whose ::after stretches over the card. Safe over a carousel — the scroll-button/marker pseudos sit at z-index 3 and the overlay furniture at 2, against the cover's 1. Exactly one per card: nested anchors are invalid, so tag and action links are raised above it instead.

eyebrow.title: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: Category / kicker shown above the headline. Emitted as articleSection, category, recipeCategory or about depending on schemaType.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Primary headline. Emitted as headline (article/news), title (job) or name (all other types). Short rich text: inline <b> (emphasis) and <ui-gradient-text> (gradient treatment, optional animate slide|breathe and a bounded gradient="<colour stops>" list — hex, rgb()/hsl()/var() names, ≤80 chars) pass through; all other markup is stripped/escaped. Keep ≤256 chars — if the CMS cannot constrain rich text length, fall back to a plain rich text field. Plain strings remain valid.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Brief summary. Emitted as description — or reviewBody (review), text (quote/social).

readingTime.title: Reading Time
readingTime.description: Human-readable reading time, e.g. “5 min read”

media.title: Media
media.description: Media items rendered inside <ui-media>. One item = single frame; multiple items = carousel (nav dots/arrows).

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: Image or video asset from the media library

src.title: External Source
src.description: External URL or provider video id — used when no asset is set (e.g. YouTube/Vimeo id). Map only: an explicit embed URL, bypassing the provider builder

provider.title: Map Provider
provider.description: Map only — google needs details.map.key; anything unbuildable falls back to OpenStreetMap

layer.title: Map Basemap
layer.description: Map only — the OpenStreetMap embed's layer= string. Allowlisted to the six basemaps OSM can embed; anything else renders Standard, which is what the embed itself does with an unknown id. tracestracktopo and openmaptiles_osm are in the OSM switcher but carry no canEmbed flag, so they are deliberately not offered.

latitude.title: Map Latitude
latitude.description: Map only — overrides details.geo.latitude when the map must show a different point

longitude.title: Map Longitude
longitude.description: Map only — overrides details.geo.longitude when the map must show a different point

alt.title: Alt Text
alt.description: Accessible description of the media item

poster.title: Poster
poster.description: Video/audio only — the still shown before playback, and the visual an audio item keeps in the frame

controls.title: Native Controls
controls.description: Video only — show the browser's own controls

autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.description: Video only — implies muted; the renderer also sets playsinline

muted.title: Muted
muted.description: Video only — forced on when autoplay is set

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Video only, ISO 8601 (e.g. PT2M10S) → VideoObject duration

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: Authors / reviewers / speakers — rendered as byline, emitted as author → Person

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Keywords — rendered as pill list (data-part="tags"), emitted as keywords

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Call-to-action buttons (data-part="actions"). icon names a glyph from @browser.style/icon (icons.json) drawn before the text; iconAt "end" puts it after — a chevron's place. Unknown names are silently blank.

links.title: Links
links.description: Plain related links (rendered as text links, not buttons). Envelope tags accept a string or {name, url} — a linked tag renders an anchor inside the chip. An action with no link.url renders a real button element (with optional ariaLabel); modifiedDisplay adds a visible Updated line beside the machine dateModified

furniture.title: Furniture
furniture.description: Overlay elements placed on top of the media area: a chip label, a beacon (live/status indicator), a sticker callout, a save/favorite toggle and a play affordance. This model carries only their TEXT/semantic content — position, hue, size and shape are set in the preset's media= token string (chip/sticker/save/play/beacon tokens), optionally overridden per item via 'style'.

chip.title: Chip
chip.description: Small pill label overlaid on the media (<ui-chip>) — replaces the legacy ribbon.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Optional count/label rendered as a nested <ui-badge> (e.g. "4").

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra chip() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "red" or "bs red". Overrides the preset for the same axis (position/hue).

beacon.title: Beacon
beacon.description: Live/status indicator overlaid on the media (<ui-beacon>) — the animated counterpart to the static chip (e.g. LIVE, REC, Breaking). Marker-class: rendered text-only. Animations are gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; the paused attribute freezes a running one.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra beacon() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "red sld bln" or "ts pll". Axes: position (ts…be) · hue (red…white) · face (dts dots | pll pill | sld solid | tck ticker) · animation (bln blink | pls pulse | brt breathe | non none) · size (xs sm md lg xl 2xl) · corner (rnd sqr). Overrides the preset for the same axis.

sticker.title: Sticker
sticker.description: Callout disc/shape overlaid on the media (<ui-sticker>). Its multi-line typography is authored as 'lines' — each line renders as its own element and is styled by the sticker's font= / font-lead= tokens.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: One entry per typographic line. 'label' → <small> (font=), 'lead' → <strong> (font-lead=), 'plain' → <span> (fluid). Optional 'sup' renders a trailing <sup> (e.g. price cents).

sup.title: Superscript
sup.description: Optional <sup> appended after the text, e.g. price cents.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra sticker() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "sh:burst red" or "te sh:heart". Overrides the preset for the same axis (position/hue/shape).

marquee.title: Marquee
marquee.description: Full-width scrolling text band across the media (<ui-marquee>) — a BAND, not 9-grid furniture: it spans the frame's inline size, is positioned only top (default) or bot, and sits below the point furniture (chip/beacon/sticker). Text renders via aria-label on an empty element — no child markup.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra marquee() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "red sm rpt" or "bot fade". Overrides the preset for the same axis (position/hue/size/mode); unknown words are dropped by the renderer.

save.title: Save
save.description: Save/favorite toggle overlaid on the media (<ui-save>). The boolean value true is also accepted and defaults to a heart.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra save() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "orange sm" or "non" (hide the disc).

lightbox.title: Lightbox
lightbox.description: View-gallery / fullscreen toggle overlaid on the media (<ui-lightbox>). The renderer marks the frame as a popover and points the invoker at it (built-in toggle-popover command); the open-state presentation comes from the preset's open: tokens. The boolean value true is also accepted.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra lightbox() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "white sm" or "non" (hide the disc).

play.title: Play
play.description: Play/pause affordance overlaid on the media (<ui-play>) — for videos and autoplay carousels, where it becomes the sole play/pause control. The boolean value true is also accepted.

style.title: Style override
style.description: Extra play() tokens appended after the preset, e.g. "lg" or "bs".

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Interaction statistics — emitted as interactionStatistic → InteractionCounter (WatchAction/LikeAction/ShareAction/CommentAction)

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Reference to a card-preset defining the look & feel: the host element (<ui-card> or <ui-reveal>) and its variant/media/content attribute token strings. Swap the reference to restyle the card without touching content. Falls back to the renderer's default (stack) when unset.

flipside.title: Flipside
flipside.description: Optional reference to another card whose content renders as the reveal back panel. Only used when the preset's element is ui-reveal. Unset: the back panel is derived from this card's own envelope + details. The flipside shares the host's schema.org scope — use the same schemaType (or the neutral 'content') to keep microdata coherent. Resolved one level deep; a flipside's own flipside is ignored.

details.title: Type Details
details.description: One object per card, discriminated by schemaType. The machine contract is ui/card/data/details.json (per-type fields, controls and lookup vocabularies — regenerated into the card editor by ui/card/details.build.js); the editor-facing reference is ui/card/docs/card.model.md § Per-type details. details.subtype (allowlisted schema.org subtype) exists for exactly the SUBTYPES families in render.js: article, business, event, location, news, organization, product, social, software. details.paywalled (boolean) is accepted on every type whose itemtype is a CreativeWork, Event or Place (PAYWALL_TYPES in render.js) and emits isAccessibleForFree: False. Keys ending in "Display" are presentation twins and emit no microdata. Array fields declaring `ref` accept { "$ref": "card/<id>" } rows beside inline rows — the referenced card's fields project onto the row shape (the manifest's ref.project), and inline keys on the row win: product.variants.items, faq.items, places.items, podcastseries.episodes.
